commands.label: Reset DB (hard)
commands.script: pnpm db:stop && pnpm db:start && pnpm db:push && pnpm db:seed
commands.description: Wipe + restart Postgres, push schema, seed
commands.ai: Stops the Docker Postgres container, restarts it, pushes the Prisma schema, and seeds demo data. Use this when the DB is in a broken state or after a schema overhaul. Requires Docker to be running.

commands.label: Full reset
commands.script: pnpm install && pnpm db:push && pnpm dev
commands.ai: Reinstalls all pnpm workspace dependencies, applies the latest Prisma schema, then starts all dev servers (SaaS on :3000, Marketing on :3001). Run this after pulling major changes.

commands.label: Check everything
commands.description: Biome + TypeScript — must be green before commit
commands.ai: Runs Biome formatter+linter with auto-fix, then tsc --noEmit across all workspaces. Both must exit 0 before any git commit. Fix Biome issues first, then type errors.
